templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a services agreement governing the provider's AI services, including customer Input, generated Output, and restrictions on training models with customer data.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and term and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Agreement governing a provider's processing of customer personal data, covering controller/processor roles, subprocessors, security, data subject requests, and international transfers.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback, with terms on confidentiality, IP ownership, and term.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality period, governing law, and jurisdiction, and sign.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a stated purpose, with obligations on use, protection, and return of that information.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships such as referral, reseller, or co-marketing arrangements, covering each party's obligations, trademark use, payments, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term agreement allowing a prospective customer to trial or evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial contract.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for professional services delivered under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level commitments for a cloud service, defining uptime targets, support response times, and service credits when targets are missed.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing installable or on-premise software, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability.
